what: The artwork (arm, hand, props) hides off-screen to the left by its own width, then when its top edge reaches the screen center it slides snappily into place over 1s (cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1)). Scrolling back up pulls it out again — like an arm handing over a letter at the tail end.

options.from: If right, it enters from off-screen right (default is left)
options.start: Entry position (ScrollTrigger start), default top center

note: The parent must be overflow: hidden so there is no horizontal overflow while hidden

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .g-cta__arm (arm reaching out to the flower letter in the closing contact)
